verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own pricing page lists a Business SMS Booster add-on to "manage customer texts with a shared inbox, templates, and compliance tools," which covers the core of team texts landing in one inbox. The evidence is a single marketing line on a paid add-on, and nothing shows that replies are attributed to individual agents. Missing for 10: evidence of per-agent reply attribution, detail on how inbound texts to the business number route into the shared inbox, in-depth first-party docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
